_comment: Row 723. Six seams of the real-Chrome -> bundled-Chromium degradation record: the cloak.persistent_context arm (both outcomes) and its retry predicate, and the runner_browser persistent and non-persistent arms plus the drain that surfaces login/replay notes. Every anchor is zero-width (lookbehind + lookahead) and names a DECISION -- a call site or a branch predicate -- never a value. Filed after lens L2 refused this cut for leaving the cloak arm unguarded.
subject: cloak.persistent_context / runner_browser._record_channel_fallback -- the degradation the run record must carry

mutants.label: M1 cloak arm: the RECOVERED fallback is never recorded (the exact deletion L2 measured)
M2 cloak arm: a bundled retry that ALSO fails is never recorded
M3 cloak arm: invert the channel_fallback predicate so the retry never runs
M4 runner persistent arm: the recovered fallback never reaches the run record
M5 runner non-persistent arm: the recovered fallback never reaches the run record
M6 the drain that surfaces login/replay notes returns nothing, so no runner ever reports them
